issues.issue: Whether the 2013 arrest and LTTE-linked detention account is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he was arrested and beaten in 2013 for helping relatives move in Colombo.
issues.result_text: Inconsistent accounts and an unexplained omission of a name undermine credibility; explanation unreasonable.

issues.issue: Whether the 2014 arrest at the shipping centre is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says police arrested him at the shipping centre while he was looking for a job in 2014.
issues.result_text: Implausible account of police knowledge and timing; negatively impacts the persecution allegation.

issues.issue: Whether the return to Sri Lanka and delay in claiming undermine subjective fear
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says a ship captain withheld his passport and he returned to Sri Lanka before leaving for the US.
issues.result_text: Return and delay in claiming refugee status in the US are inconsistent with genuine fear of persecution.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces risk on return as a young Tamil male or a failed refugee (ss.96 and 97)
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he will be stopped, jailed or questioned if he returns to Sri Lanka.
issues.result_text: No serious possibility of persecution from profile alone; not wanted by police; s.97 threshold not met.
